notes.text: Shared October calendar initialized from September 30 and October 1 report evidence. Schedules are inherited, not newly verified at migration; source publication/retrieval times are missing where noted. Absence from a later report is not cancellation.

Complete event revisions are append-only. Corrections retain the previous event and state a reason; cancellation requires a verified source notice. No cancellation notice was present in these inputs. Dates are displayed in MYT; source ET dates and time windows are retained. The inherited combined events should be split only through documented revisions.
